question: Which committee was appointed by SEBI to advise on the development of appropriate regulatory framework for derivatives trading in India in the year 1996?
solution:
The correct answer is **__L.C. Gupta Committee.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **L.C.Gupta Committee** was formed in **November 1996** for the** regulation of derivatives trading**.
 
• **Balwant Rai Committee **was formed in 1957 to examine the implementation of the Community Development Programme, 1952 and the National Extension Service, 1953 at the rural level.</strong&
